adjective smiling, plural nominative feminine describing the Śaktis
compound varā (boon) + abhaya (fearlessness) + kara (hand) + anvitā (endowed), plural nominative feminine

items.question: What facial and hand attributes characterize these earth-dwelling Śaktis as gracious?
premises: They bear boon and fearlessness hands.
items.inference: These Śaktis appear gracious and protective.
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'they' depends on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: They have pleased faces, smile, and are endowed with hands granting boons and fearlessness.
